excerpts.author: sproul
excerpts.content:
yeah I think we are too late in the process to fix anything for mainnet, so plan of action should be:

- LH reverts to the old behaviour on v1 endpoint (I'm looking into how hard this is to do)
- We introduce v2 proposer duties for Glamsterdam and deprecate v1 at Glamsterdam

excerpts.author: dgusakov
excerpts.content: In our use case (historical performance calculation), proposer_lookahead is not a perfect fit

excerpts.content: LH impl doesn’t seem too bad, so we’re on track

excerpts.author: jtraglia
excerpts.content: Hey consensus devs, we just published the [v1.6.0-beta.2](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/releases/tag/v1.6.0-beta.2) release! It includes no changes to Fulu. This release is mostly focussed around improving the Gloas specifications & testing. To be clear, it does not set the upgrade schedule for Fulu as discussed at ACDC today. Please take a moment to review the [Set fork epoch & blob schedule for Fulu](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4689) PR. We are planning to make the stable v1.6.0 release as soon as it's merged 🙂

excerpts.author: jtraglia
excerpts.content: Heads up. There was a mistake (my fault) in the tests for this release; there are many missing tests. I'm going to regenerate the reference tests with the fix & update the release assets. Sorry about this. Should be fixed within 2 hours.
